items.title: H.D. Pant Shrink Wool, Dark Navy
items.note: The H.D. is Needles' big, voluminous pant, here in a heavyweight wool blend. Deep pleats at the waist and hem give it a wide, sculpted shape, with a drawstring waist and cupro lining behind the knees.

items.title: Railroad Zip Jacket, Melange Double Cloth Brown
items.note: A workwear jacket in a mélange double cloth with some depth to it. It has a relaxed cut, a plain zip front and a purple lining. There is a matching Railroad Pant if you want the set.

items.title: Watch Cap Shetland Wool, Umber
items.note: A simple rib-knit beanie in Shetland wool with the small purple Papillon butterfly embroidered on. An easy way into the brand. It also comes in black, with matching Shetland gloves.

items.title: Double Face Cotton Two Pleats Trouser, Black
items.note: Two-pleat trousers in a dense double-weave cotton twill, woven on old wool looms so it has real body. The face is black and the reverse is brown, which shows a little as it moves. A quieter label worth knowing.

items.title: Dyed Denim Work Jacket, Cub Brown
items.note: A work jacket in the brand's own 13.5oz denim, mercerised and garment-dyed brown. It is lined in cotton flannel and has a zip front, buckles at the hem and adjustable cuffs. The matching Riviera Pants came in too.

items.title: Three-Dimensional Down Parka, After Dark
items.note: A light down parka with 3D box baffles that the shop says take their cue from origami folds. The shell is 10-denier nylon ripstop and it packs down. Sculptural, but still a practical winter coat.

items.title: Beefroll Loafer, Black
items.note: A classic beefroll loafer from the long-running Japanese shoemaker, built on its saddle shoe last. It uses kip leather and suede from Sanyo Leather, with a GORE-TEX lining and a light Vibram sole. Good for wide trousers in wet weather.

items.title: Balloon Wide Pants, Ash Grey
items.note: Goodhood's newest men's stock is almost all Beams right now: wide chinos, wide denim, tweed coats and these balloon pants. I couldn't open the product page this week, so this is just the name and price from the listing. Worth a look if you like the shape.

items.title: A.PRESSE
items.note: A Tokyo label that remakes vintage pieces like flight jackets, deck jackets and beach cloth in very good fabrics. Haven just took in a big delivery, from cashmere coats to washed wide denim. Pricey, but this one, the Cashmere Beach Cloth Jacket, is cotton slub outside and brushed cashmere inside.

items.title: HERILL
items.note: A Japanese label built around fabric. Haven has a Rigidwool range made for the shop, including this zip-up jacket based on old swing-top jackets, in long-staple wool with a softening finish. There are matching jungle fatigue pants and a field coat too.
